extract_coolant_info(geom, filepath)[source]#

Extracts coolant information that varies during the cycle from a PARCS cycle summary file. The information extracted includes coolant density for each assembly in the core, including reflector assemblies.

Parameters:

  • filepath (str | Path)

Return type:

None

extract_spectrum(sp, file_content, ngroups)[source]#

Extracts neutron spectrum from a Polaris (SCALE) spectrum file. The spectrum is extracted for a given statepoint (sp) and number of energy groups (ngroups). Returns a list of tuples containing (energy_bin_midpoint, chi_value). The extract spectrum function is used in two of the polarisoption for lattice composition extraction.

Return type:

List[Tuple[float, float]]
